projects.title: Indo Korean
projects.story: Exploring the rich cultural intersections between India and Korea, this documentary weaves together personal narratives, culinary traditions, and visual artistry into a seamless, cinematic journey.

projects.title: Real Estate
projects.story: A premium showcase of modern architectural marvels. We focused on capturing the scale, light, and luxury of these properties using sweeping drone shots and intimate interior details.

projects.title: Young Indians
projects.story: A gritty, authentic look into the lives of the next generation. We followed subjects across the country to capture their drive, their challenges, and their unbroken spirit.

projects.title: Naveen Sharlien Wedding
projects.story: A beautiful celebration of love. We captured the intimate moments, the grand celebrations, and the raw emotions of Naveen and Sharlien’s special day, creating a cinematic wedding film that they will cherish forever.

projects.title: Srusti Pratik Haldi
projects.story: A vibrant explosion of color, tradition, and pure joy. We documented the beautiful Haldi ceremony of Srusti and Pratik, focusing on the intimate rituals and the beautiful chaos of family celebrations.
